title_de: International Game für die San Francisco 49ers?
teaser_de: Welche Spiele kommen für ein International Game der 49ers überhaupt in Frage? Ein Überblick für alle Fans in Europa.
title_en: An international game for the San Francisco 49ers?
teaser_en: Which games could even become an international game for the 49ers? An overview for fans in Europe.
body_en:
Since we are currently receiving many questions about possible international games in the 2025 season, we want to bring some clarity with this article. So which games even come into question?

### Berlin Game 2025

As is well known, the designated home team for the game in Berlin is the Indianapolis Colts. The 49ers are one of nine teams playing at the Colts in the 2025 season. However, the 49ers themselves do not hold any NFL marketing rights in Germany.

### London Games 2025

Another 49ers road game in 2025 is at the Cleveland Browns. Here, too, we are one of nine teams that could be the opponent for the Browns' game at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. In addition, the 49ers hold NFL marketing rights in the United Kingdom.

### Mexico Game 2025

Besides the Denver Broncos, the Houston Texans have also been floated for the 2025 Mexico Game. We also have a road game at the Texans in 2025, and the 49ers also hold NFL marketing rights in Mexico. The home team for the 2025 Mexico Game has not been officially confirmed yet.

In theory, then, the chances of another international game in 2025 are higher than in previous years. About two weeks ago, owner Jed York mentioned in an interview that he does not expect the 49ers to play an international game in Europe in the next two years. We find it hard to imagine that the NFL would schedule these games over the teams' heads. Because of the added travel strain and prior discussions about new market shares in Europe, there is always an exchange between the NFL and the teams ahead of these games.

Over the past year and a half, we have raised the topics of the 49ers' marketing rights in Germany and the large German 49ers community again and again in all kinds of places. We talked and wrote about it with the fan liaisons and various beat writers, we briefly introduced ourselves to owner Jed York and president Al Guido during our group trips and mentioned that there are a great many 49ers fans in Germany, and we even exchanged ideas with the 49ers' brand marketing team. Despite large travel groups, the 49ers never showed any real interest in the "German market."

For these reasons, we consider an international game in Mexico at the Houston Texans in 2025 the most realistic option. We also continue to assume that if the 49ers play a game in Europe in the coming years, it would be in the United Kingdom. The NFL does not bring its international games to these countries and cities for sentimental reasons, but because it wants to keep expanding its market and its profits outside the USA. That is why the marketing rights the NFL grants to teams in individual countries play a central role. Whoever holds the NFL marketing rights in a country has better chances of an international game there. Teams that want NFL marketing rights in a particular country have to apply for them proactively with the NFL. We are not aware of any efforts by the 49ers in this direction regarding Germany. In the 2024 season, a total of 25 teams held marketing rights in 19 different countries ([see here](https://www.nfl.com/international/global-markets-program)). The 49ers already hold marketing rights in the United Kingdom and Mexico, while some teams have only one market or no rights at all. In addition, ten other teams already hold the rights in Germany.

Of course, we neither can nor want to completely rule out a 49ers international game in the UK or in Berlin in 2025. All we can do is gather the relevant information soberly, without our fan glasses on, and draw our conclusions from it. Within The Niner Empire Germany e.V., too, there are many Faithful who would be thrilled about a San Francisco 49ers game on their own doorstep, or at least in Europe.

### Will membership in The Niner Empire Germany e.V. make it easier to get tickets for 49ers games in Europe?

This is a question we have been asked a lot recently. In principle, just like with our group trips, we only have influence on 49ers home games. For group tickets at Levi's Stadium, for example, we save the high service fees and real money. At the international games in Germany, the United Kingdom or Mexico mentioned above, the 49ers would be the road team. Control over the tickets would lie with the Colts for the Berlin Game, and with the NFL itself for international games in general. Our contacts in the 49ers ticketing department therefore don't really help us here. On top of that, the tickets are sold through Ticketmaster and other platforms, so arrangements would also have to be made with them. NFL ticketing is in no way comparable to ticketing for European sporting events. Away allocations, or allocations of any kind like those at German soccer matches, simply do not exist in the NFL. We have also covered how ticket prices develop and come about in the travel information on our homepage.

### What we can guarantee you

Should there be an international game in Berlin or London, we will tap all our contacts and relationships in the NFL and 49ers landscape in the USA and in Germany and do everything possible to secure at least a small allocation for our members.

We hope this article has shed some light on how international games are awarded and given you a realistic assessment of the situation.

Faithful to the Bay
